salesCopy.tagline: Your Journal as a Life Operating System
salesCopy.secondaryTagline: Stop Blanking When Someone Asks "What Did You Do This Month?"
salesCopy.problem: Your life is slipping away, one forgotten moment at a time.
problemPoints: End of months feel empty—busy but nothing to show
Beautiful moments with loved ones fade into nothing
Brilliant ideas vanish before you can act on them
You blank when someone asks what you accomplished
Life feels like it's happening TO you, not BY you
salesCopy.agitate: Your brain wasn't designed to remember. That golden sunset walk with your partner? Gone in days. That breakthrough insight in the shower? Forgotten by lunch. That heartfelt conversation with your kids? A blur by next week. The brain is functional, not faithful—it forgets what you don't actively reinforce.
salesCopy.solution: A journaling system that becomes the foundation of your entire life. Not a diary. Not "Dear Diary" feelings. A personal operating system that captures what matters, tracks what you achieve, and keeps you focused on what's next.
solutionPoints: Capture moments before they vanish forever
Track progress so you can actually SEE your growth
Stay focused on what truly matters
salesCopy.credibilityStory: I manage **3 kids**, run my own company half-time while working as an IT Solution Architect for a large financial organization, write books, articles, newsletters, build communities, and develop software. My life is **BUSY**. Yet I'm almost always calm, '**zen**', free from the frenzy many face with far fewer responsibilities. The difference? The journaling system I've refined for **over a decade**. I've accumulated **10,000+ interconnected notes**. This isn't theory—it's the exact system that makes my complex life sustainable and intentional.
salesCopy.description: An **80-minute deep dive masterclass** revealing how journaling becomes your complete life operating system. Learn the '*interstitial journaling*' approach—capturing insights throughout your day without breaking flow—plus periodic reviews that compound your growth across weeks, months, and years.
features: **80-minute video recording** of the complete system
Complete show notes with agenda and key takeaways
**Real examples** from my actual daily/weekly notes
Brain science behind why this works

immediate: **Stop blanking** when someone asks about your week
longTerm: Look back on years with **richness**, not blankness

misconceptionBusters.truth: This is a **life operating system**—capturing ideas, tracking goals, processing experiences, and building compounding knowledge. Feelings optional.
*Interstitial journaling* happens in moments throughout the day—a few seconds here, a minute there. **No dedicated 'journaling time' required**.

misconceptionBusters.myth: You need to be a 'writer' to journal
misconceptionBusters.truth: You're **capturing**, not composing. Quick notes, bullet points, screenshots, links—whatever captures the moment fastest.
